objective: Resolve systemic timeouts and simulation schema issues observed in the failed governed run 03feb3227318 by adopting a delta execution strategy, establishing a more resilient execution pattern for complex simulations without altering buyer-visible dashboard output, standalone presentation semantics, or underlying data definitions.

journeys.name: Validate delta execution strategy and execution timing under timeout limits
journeys.goal: An author or operator validates that large and complex simulations execute using a delta execution strategy with intermediate checkpoints, completing well within per-step execution time limits without systemic timeouts or cascading retries.

steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/delta-sim-test.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/delta-sim-test.snapshot.json --force from workspace root.
Verify the simulation command completes in seconds, well under the 600-second worker timeout limit, and creates both SQLite and JSON snapshot outputs.
Run python3 -m pytest tests/test_idle_warehouse_waste.py -q -k test_bit_for_bit_deterministic_generation to confirm deterministic generation across delta execution steps.
